Priya Nair: ran a monthly pattern-vector pass for FebApr and wanted to surface a slightly different distribution than last quarter. pulled signals from postmortems, alert traces, and qps-correlated failure windows. summary below + suggested triage owners.

Omar Haddad: thanks Priya 1 Can you drop the top 6 signatures + how many tickets each produced?

Priya Nair: quick table from the query i ran: 

```
signature | ticket_count | pct_of_total
NETWORK_EGRESS_BLIP | 17 | 22%
MODEL_WEIGHT_MISMATCH | 12 | 15%
SCHEDULER_PREEMPT_RACE | 11 | 14%
TPU_TEMP_SPIKE_NODEPOOL | 9 | 11%
KV_CACHE_LARGE_TENANT_THRASH | 8 | 10%
GRPC_STREAM_RESET_CLIENT | 7 | 9%
other | 13 | 19%
```

Query used: `SELECT signature, count(*) as ticket_count, round(count(*)*100.0/(SELECT count(*) FROM incidents WHERE detected_at >= '2026-02-01'),1) as pct_of_total FROM incidents WHERE detected_at >= '2026-02-01' GROUP BY signature ORDER BY ticket_count DESC LIMIT 10;`

Lena Park: interesting that network egress blips are top. many of those trace back to a flaky egress firewall rule in us-west-2 from Feb 1421 incidents. we should mark that as infrastructure cause vs runtime. i'll add list of infra owners.

Kai Mfcller: i'll take MODEL_WEIGHT_MISMATCH. hypothesis: our new model import pipeline didn't validate dtype/shape for a small set of sharded checkpoints -> runtime asserts. remediation plan: add schema validation + baked-in unit test in model onboarding. ETA 2 weeks.

Priya Nair: good. owners suggested:
- NETWORK_EGRESS_BLIP -> Eng-Infra (Lena) + NetOps, interim mitigation: egress retry backoff and alert throttling, due 2026-04-06
- MODEL_WEIGHT_MISMATCH -> Kai Mfcller, add schema checks, due 2026-04-12
- SCHEDULER_PREEMPT_RACE -> Omar Haddad, add lock around job preempt path + metrics, due 2026-04-15
- TPU_TEMP_SPIKE_NODEPOOL -> Infra HW team, add thermal backoff + drain policy, due 2026-04-20
- KV_CACHE_LARGE_TENANT_THRASH -> follow-up with runtime team for tenant isolation, due 2026-04-18
- GRPC_STREAM_RESET_CLIENT -> add client retry and increased idle keepalive, due 2026-04-10

Omar Haddad: i can own scheduler preempt race. plan: reproduce with synthetic preemption load, add distributed lock (fallback to queue) and a canary. will estimate SLO impact in PR.

Lena Park: will coordinate with NetOps and file infra incident followup tickets. i also want to propose a weekly "pattern triage" slot to avoid backlog. propose Wednesdays 9am PT.

Priya Nair: +1 to weekly triage. i'll create epic INC-4410: "Pattern vectors: FebApr remediation" and seed the tickets. incidents-bot, create epic please.

incidents-bot: Created epic INC-4410: "Pattern vectors: Feb-Apr remediation" and added labels: pattern-analysis, triage-weekly. https://jira.local/browse/INC-4410

Kai Mfcller: also flagging risk: model schema validator needs to run on existing catalog to avoid regressions. scheduling a one-off job to scan ~300 models. ETA for scan: 4 days.

Priya Nair: action items (add to INC-4410):
- Lena Park 1 file infra followups for egress rule + implement egress retry backoff  due 2026-04-06
- Kai Mfcller 1 model import schema checks + scan catalog  due 2026-04-12 (scan by 2026-04-04)
- Omar Haddad 1 scheduler preempt fix + synthetic test harness  due 2026-04-15
- Runtime team (assigned: TBA) 1 tenant isolation adjustments for KV cache + eviction metrics  due 2026-04-18
- Platform SRE (assigned: TBA) 1 grpc keepalive defaults + client retry guidance  due 2026-04-10

Omar Haddad: i'll reach out to runtime leads and drop owners into the epic.

Lena Park: i've added a short incident note on the infra dashboard and will put the weekly triage invite on the calendar.

Priya Nair: let's reconvene on Wed 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC for the first triage. if anyone spots a higher-priority regression in the meantime, ping this thread and we'll bump. :eyes:

incidents-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Pattern triage: INC-4410 sync" on 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC.
